newsitem.title: USA: Eagle USA plunges on Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Eagle USA plunges on Q2 results.

text.p: Shares of Eagle USA Airfreight Inc dropped 33 percent after its second quarter results failed to meet Wall Street expectations, analysts said.
Eagle USA, which provides air freight forwarding services, lost 10 points to 20-1/2.

After the market closed Monday, Eagle USA posted second-quarter earnings of $0.16 a share on revenues of $61.5 million. These results surpassed that year's second quarter earnings of $0.11, but fell short of analysts' consensus estimate of $0.17 a share, according to First Call.with
Results for the second quarter ended March 31 also fell short of results for the first quarter ended December 31.

"Considering the fact that this quarter is traditionally our slowest, we had outstanding revenue and earnings growth over previous fiscal year comparisons. Our business continues to be strong," James Crane, Eagle USA's chairman and chief executive officer.
Some analysts said the market overreacted to the earnings shortfall since Eagle USA remains on track for the rest of the year.
"There was a little bit too much optimism out there," said Paul Schlesinger, an analyst with Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
Eagle USA's earnings exceeded Schlesinger's second-quarter forecast of $0.15 a share.
"The composition of the numbers made it look a little difficult to get there, but they beat my number," Schlesinger said.
